item.title: I bought Friendster for $30k – Here's what I'm doing with it
Self-updating screenshots
item.description:
📝 png ':screenshot') That HTML comment is an instruction to the screenshot system. The satisfying bit The whole pipeline runs with just this: rails manual:build That captures every screenshot and then builds all the help pages. No manual cropping, no “oh I forgot to update that one”, no slowly-diverging screenshots that make the help centre look abandoned.

item.title: Fast16: High-precision software sabotage 5 years before Stuxnet
item.description:
📝 The binary includes a crucial detail: a PDB path that links the binary to the kernel driver fast16. Following that clue led us to a second binary, fast16. 00 (native), Intel i386, 5 sections Link Time 2005-07-19 15:15:41 UTC (0x42dd191d) This kernel driver is a boot-start filesystem component that intercepts and modifies executable code as it’s read from disk.
🔗 Read more: https://www.sentinelone.com/labs/fast16-mystery-shadowbrokers-reference-reveals-high-precision-software-sabotage-5-years-before-stuxnet/

item.title: Chernobyl wildlife forty years on
item.description:
📝 This frog raised a question that many have asked ever since the explosion at Chernobyl: had radiation from the stricken power station changed the creatures living near it. Recently, researchers have highlighted other reasons why some animals may have flourished in this injured landscape. He also notes that radiation levels have changed since the time of the accident.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/future/article/20260424-chernobyl-wildlife-forty-years-on
